package consumer

import (
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/conformance/relationfixture/authors"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/conformance/relationfixture/blog"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/conformance/relationfixture/project"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/orm"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/schema/ir"
)

func mismatch() {
	binding, _ := project.Bind()
	post, _ := orm.BindModel(binding, ir.ModelIdentity{AppLabel: "blog", ModelName: "post"}, blog.PostDescriptor{})
	author, _ := orm.BindModel(binding, ir.ModelIdentity{AppLabel: "authors", ModelName: "author"}, authors.AuthorDescriptor{})
	forward, _ := orm.BindForward(post, "author", author)
	_, _ = forward.String(blog.PostFields.Title)
}
